newsitem.title: JAPAN: Akai Electric to launch DVD player at end-January.
newsitem.headline: Akai Electric to launch DVD player at end-January.

text.p: Akai Electric Co Ltd said on Monday it will launch a digital video disc (DVD) player in Japan at the end of January.
It will launch the player on the world market in April.
Akai said it would be the fourth company to enter the DVD market by developing a DVD player, following Matsushita Electric Industrial Co, Toshiba Corp and Pioneer Electronic Corp.
Monthly output for its player, the DV-P1000, could reach 50,000 units depending on demand, it said. It will have a suggested retail price of 80,000 yen.
Toshiba and Matsushita started selling DVD players in Japan on November 1, but a lack of attractive software titles has kept their sales lacklustre.
The DVD format is expected to eventually replace video movies, compact discs (CDs) and CD-ROMs. A DVD looks like a CD, but can hold seven to 14 times as much data.
